description: One payroll run, 1:1 with a POSTED Reconciliation Run. Maps that run's Payable Lines (GROSS) onto stock Salary Slips, nets verified consented deductions, and orchestrates the regional WPS/SIF file. Custom code sets provenance + gate flags only; stock HRMS computes gross/deduction/net. RELEASE (WPS to bank) is the P-193-gated action (enforce_gate wps_release); it fails closed until every worker has a valid IBAN, every deduction has a verified consent, and Separation of Duties holds.

fields.description: Client this run pays workers for.
fields.label: Client

fields.description: Optional. Leave blank for a client-wide run.
fields.label: Branch Site

fields.description: The pay cycle. Amounts snapshot at this period cutoff.
fields.label: Timesheet Period

fields.description: The POSTED Reconciliation Run whose Payable Lines are the ONLY gross source for this payroll. Never hand-key gross.
fields.label: Reconciliation Run

fields.description: Runtime rollup of Salary Slip gross. Never a seeded config value.
fields.label: Total Gross

fields.description: Runtime net = the WPS bank total. Stock HRMS never lets a slip net fall below zero on the WPS line.
fields.label: Total Net (WPS)

fields.description: Count of slips still missing a verified consent for a deduction. Must be 0 to RELEASE.
fields.label: Open Consent Gaps

fields.description: Regional wage-protection channel the SIF file targets. The file itself is produced by the chosen export app (D10 procurement), never by this app.
fields.label: WPS Channel

fields.description: WPS-COMPLETE precondition: 1 only when every included worker has a valid IBAN. Computed; release fails closed while 0.
fields.label: IBAN Complete

fields.description: Delegation-of-Authority band this release falls in. Resolved via P-193 from the run net amount; values seeded out-of-repo.
fields.label: DoA Band

fields.description: Who prepared the run (maker). Must differ from the releaser.
fields.label: Prepared By

fields.description: Who released the WPS file (checker). Must differ from the preparer (Separation of Duties).
fields.label: Released By

fields.description: Set when this run is a same-period correction of an earlier version. A released run is never edited; a correction is a new v{n+1}.
fields.label: Correction Of
